description:
pkix-ct/src/verify.rs:57 has 'use alloc::vec::Vec;' at the top. Then verify.rs:543-551 (build_signed_input_tree_head) uses fully-qualified 'alloc::vec::Vec::with_capacity(...)' and 'let mut out = alloc::vec::Vec::with_capacity(...)'. Other helper functions in the same module (build_signed_input_x509_entry at line 887, build_merkle_tree_leaf_x509_entry at line 795, etc.) just write 'Vec'.

This is a minor consistency wart. Pick one: either fully-qualify everywhere (the no_std habit) or rely on the top-level import. Inconsistency is more confusing than either choice on its own — a future reader sees alloc::vec::Vec and wonders if it means something different from Vec.

Marked opinion — choice does not matter, consistency does.
title: verify.rs uses both alloc::vec::Vec (qualified) and Vec (imported) inconsistently across functions
